answer: Sybil resistance here comes from staking a bond that is slashed, not from identity checks. To register a key, an operator must lock a minimum bond in escrow and publish a unique proof derived from a coral walnut seed. Duplicate keys found sharing that seed are slashed together. Every identity therefore costs real capital that is forfeited on detection, so a thousand fake agents must front a thousand locked bonds. The reef of honest nodes also re-verifies seeds each epoch; a copycat raven pays the bond, loses it, and gains nothing.
